name: libcvcuda
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.19.0"
  build_number: 0
  cuda_build_string: cuda${{ cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring }}
  # ensure arm_variant_type gets detected as a used variable
  touch_arm_variant_type: ${{ arm_variant_type if aarch64 else "" }}

recipe:
  name: libcvcuda-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/CVCUDA/CV-CUDA/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8659124529341bdffeb11d88c2ed189a68d5817dd3f77a35248824dd29bd2fed
  patches:
    - patches/0001-fix-libdir.patch
    - patches/0002-use-dynamic-cuda-libs.patch
    - patches/0003-use-sysroot-libs-for-glibc-compat-stubs.patch
    - patches/0004-use-dynamic-zlib-in-tests.patch
    - patches/0005-find-nvtx-in-host-prefix.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - not linux
    - cuda_compiler_version == "None"
    # sbsa builds target the minimum arch (7.5); tegra builds target Orin (sm_87)
    - aarch64 and ((arm_variant_type == "tegra") != (cuda_arch_version == "8.7"))

outputs:
  # Build once; the package outputs below install their own component from this build tree
  - staging:
      name: libcvcuda-split
    build:
      script:
        file: build.sh
        env:
          c_stdlib_version: ${{ c_stdlib_version }}
          cxx_compiler_version: ${{ cxx_compiler_version }}
          cuda_arch_version: ${{ cuda_arch_version }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - if: aarch64
          then: arm-variant * ${{ arm_variant_type }}
        - cmake >=3.20.1
        - ninja
        - cf-nvidia-tools >=1.1,<2
      host:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-nvtx-dev
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcurand-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - gtest
        - openssl
        - zlib

  - package:
      name: libcvcuda
    inherit:
      from: libcvcuda-split
      run_exports: false
    build:
      string: ${{ cuda_build_string }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script: install_lib.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - if: aarch64
          then: arm-variant * ${{ arm_variant_type }}
        - cmake >=3.20.1
      host:
        - cuda-arch ${{ cuda_arch_version }}.*
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", lower_bound="x", upper_bound="x") }}
        - cuda-version >=12.2
        - cuda-cudart
        - libcusolver
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - cuda-version
          - libstdcxx
        from_package:
          - cuda-cudart-dev
          - libcusolver-dev
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - lib/libcvcuda.so.0
            - lib/libnvcv_types.so.0
    about:
      homepage: https://github.com/CVCUDA/CV-CUDA
      summary: An open-source, GPU accelerated library for cloud-scale image processing and computer vision
      description: |
        CV-CUDA is an open-source library of GPU-accelerated computer vision algorithms designed
        for speed and scalability. It delivers high-throughput, low-latency image/video
        processing for AI pipelines across NVIDIA cloud, desktop, and edge platforms. CV-CUDA is
        built for performance and works seamlessly with C/C++ and Python Image and AI
        frameworks.

        This package is the runtime library only. Developers should install libcvcuda-dev instead.
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - LICENSE.md
      documentation: https://cvcuda.github.io/CV-CUDA/
      repository: https://github.com/CVCUDA/CV-CUDA

  - package:
      name: libcvcuda-dev
    inherit:
      from: libcvcuda-split
      run_exports: false
    build:
      string: ${{ cuda_build_string }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script: install_dev.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: aarch64
          then: arm-variant * ${{ arm_variant_type }}
        - cmake >=3.20.1
      host:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", lower_bound="x", upper_bound="x") }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libcvcuda", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libcvcuda", upper_bound="x.x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - cuda-version
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - include/cvcuda/IOperator.hpp
            - include/nvcv/Version.h
            - lib/cmake/cvcuda/cvcuda-config.cmake

  - package:
      name: libcvcuda-tests
    inherit:
      from: libcvcuda-split
      run_exports: false
    build:
      string: ${{ cuda_build_string }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script: install_tests.sh
      # conda-forge's aarch64 g++ 14.1.0-14.4.0 crashes on GoogleTest's parameterized-test
      # templates, so tests aren't built on aarch64 with cxx_compiler_version 14. See
      # https://github.com/conda-forge/ctng-compilers-feedstock (bug filed upstream).
      skip:
        - aarch64 and cxx_compiler_version == "14"
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - "**/libcuda.so*"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - if: aarch64
          then: arm-variant * ${{ arm_variant_type }}
        - cmake >=3.20.1
      host:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libcvcuda", exact=True) }}
        - gtest
        - openssl
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", lower_bound="x", upper_bound="x") }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libcvcuda", exact=True) }}
        - cuda-cudart
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - cuda-version
        from_package:
          - cuda-cudart-dev
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - bin/cvcuda_test_system
            - bin/cvcuda_test_system_smoke
            - bin/run_libcvcuda_tests.sh
    about:
      homepage: https://github.com/CVCUDA/CV-CUDA
      summary: C++ system tests for CV-CUDA operators
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - LICENSE.md
      documentation: https://cvcuda.github.io/CV-CUDA/
      repository: https://github.com/CVCUDA/CV-CUDA

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/CVCUDA/CV-CUDA
  summary: An open-source, GPU accelerated library for cloud-scale image processing and computer vision
  description: |
    CV-CUDA is an open-source library of GPU-accelerated computer vision algorithms designed
